name: case-is-preserved-not-folded
why: The tempting rule nobody should implement. Folding case would make 'Acme.Orders' and 'acme.orders' one subject, which sounds helpful until it is a second lossy rewrite four SDKs must agree on, and until it mangles names meant to be read. Case-sensitive matches the ordinal treatment of every other wire value. The consequence is accepted: two teams spelling the same type differently get two subjects, which the registry's subject list makes visible.
subject: Acme.Orders.OrderCreated
